questionTitle: cyHas the tribunal previously determined the rent for your tenancy?

previousTribunalCaseReference.label: cyWhat was the tribunal's case reference number for the previous determination? (optional)
previousTribunalCaseReference.hint: cyIt's the 18-digit reference on any letter from the tribunal in your last tenancy determination application - for example, 'LON/00AD/SMO/2023/0001'

tribunalPreviouslyDeterminedRent.required: cySelect whether the tribunal has previously determined the rent for your tenancy

previousTribunalCaseReference.invalid: cyCase reference number must be in the format 'LON/00AD/SMO/2023/0001'
